| Category = Chicken recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
* [[Cookbook:Grill Seasoning|Grill Seasoning for Chicken]], as needed
* [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 1½ cups poultry stuffing (prepared to a somewhat wet and pipeable state)

== Equipment ==
* A heat-resistant towel tied into a roll with twine and soaked with oil

== Procedure ==
#Using a narrow boning knife, make a slit along the side of one of the chicken breasts, almost cutting through all the way through the side. Repeat with remaining chicken.
#Place stuffing inside a gallon size zip-top bag. Snip a small hole in one of the corners. Squeeze to dispense. Stuff each chicken breast until slit fills up halfway. [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] opening edge with Dijon mustard and press down lightly.
#Coat chicken with mustard and season liberally with Grill Seasoning. Massage seasoning in.
#Quickly swab preheated charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] with oil soaked towel. Grill chicken, turning often, until area under stuffing reaches 165°F (75°C) and stuffing reaches 165°F (75°C).
#Remove and let rest for 7 minutes. Serve.
